ayahs.ar: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Certainly will the believers have succeeded
ayahs.e2: Successful indeed are the believers
ayahs.tr: Qad aflahal mu'minoon

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي صَلَاتِهِمۡ خَٰشِعُونَ
ayahs.en: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
ayahs.e2: those who humble themselves in prayer
ayahs.tr: Allazeena hum fee Salaatihim khaashi'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَنِ ٱللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who turn away from ill speech
ayahs.e2: those who avoid idle talk
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum 'anillaghwimu'ridoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who are observant of zakah
ayahs.e2: those who pay alms-tax
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum liz Zakaati faa'iloon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who guard their private parts
ayahs.e2: those who guard their chastity
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum lifuroo jihim haafizoon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed
ayahs.e2: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame
ayahs.tr: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aimaanuhum fa innahum ghairu maloomeen

ayahs.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
ayahs.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors
ayahs.e2: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors
ayahs.tr: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
ayahs.e2: ˹the believers are also˺ those who are true to their trusts and covenants
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum li amaanaatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who carefully maintain their prayers
ayahs.e2: and those who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum 'alaa Salawaatihim yuhaafizoon

ayahs.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.en: Those are the inheritors
ayahs.e2: These are the ones who will be awarded
ayahs.tr: Ulaaa'ika humul waarisoon

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسَ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.en: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally
ayahs.e2: Paradise as their own. They will be there forever
ayahs.tr: Allazeena yarisoonal Firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةࣲ مِّن طِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay
ayahs.e2: And indeed, We created humankind from an extract of clay
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim minteen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُطۡفَةࣰ فِي قَرَارࣲ مَّكِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging
ayahs.e2: then placed each ˹human˺ as a sperm-drop in a secure place
ayahs.tr: Summa ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلنُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةࣰ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةࣰ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظَٰمࣰ ا فَكَسَوۡنَا ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ لَحۡمࣰ ا ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُ خَلۡقًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators
ayahs.e2: then We developed the drop into a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then developed the clot into a lump ˹of flesh˺, then developed the lump into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then We brought it into being as a new creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators
ayahs.tr: Summa khalaqnan nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal 'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaq nal mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal 'izaama lahman summa anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar; fatabaarakal laahu ahsanul khaaliqeen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
ayahs.en: Then indeed, after that you are to die
ayahs.e2: After that you will surely die
ayahs.tr: Summa innakum ba'da zaalika la maaiyitoon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected
ayahs.e2: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected
ayahs.tr: Summa innakum Yawmal Qiyaamati tub'asoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلۡخَلۡقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware
ayahs.e2: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraaa'iqa wa maa kunnaa 'anil khalqi ghaafileen

ayahs.ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرࣲ فَأَسۡكَنَّٰهُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابِۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away
ayahs.e2: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away
ayahs.tr: Wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil ardi wa innaa 'alaa zahaabim bihee laqaa diroon

ayahs.ar: فَأَنشَأۡنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣲ لَّكُمۡ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةࣱ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat
ayahs.e2: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat
ayahs.tr: Fa anshaanaa lakum bihee Jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naab; lakum feehaa fawaakihu kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

ayahs.ar: وَشَجَرَةࣰ تَخۡرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغࣲ لِّلۡأٓكِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat
ayahs.e2: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat
ayahs.tr: Wa shajaratan takhruju min Toori Sainaaa'a tambutu bidduhni wa sibghil lil aakileen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةࣰۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةࣱ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat
ayahs.e2: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat
ayahs.tr: Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And upon them and on ships you are carried
ayahs.e2: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships
ayahs.tr: Wa 'alaihaa wa'alal fulki tuhmaloon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi'budul laaha maa lakum min ilahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِيٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers
ayahs.e2: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers
ayahs.tr: Faqaalal mala'ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yureedu ai yatafaddala 'alaikum wa law shaaa'al laahu la anzala malaaa'ikatam maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen

ayahs.ar: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلُۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةࣱ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time
ayahs.e2: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”
ayahs.tr: In huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattan heen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me
ayahs.e2: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

ayahs.ar: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ أَنِ ٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسۡلُكۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلࣲّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبۡنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغۡرَقُونَ
ayahs.en: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned
ayahs.e2: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
ayahs.tr: Fa awhainaaa ilaihi anis na'il fulka bi a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa fa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa wa faarat tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu minhum wa laa tukhaat ibnee fil lazeena zalamooo innaahum mughraqoon

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people
ayahs.e2: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
ayahs.tr: Fa izas tawaita ata wa mam ma'aka 'alal fulki faqulil hamdu lillaahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz zalimeen

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلࣰ ا مُّبَارَكࣰ ا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us]
ayahs.e2: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qur Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw wa Anta khairul munzileen

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants]
ayahs.e2: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test
ayahs.tr: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatinw wa in kunnaa lamubtaleen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.en: Then We produced after them a generation of others
ayahs.e2: Then We raised another generation after them
ayahs.tr: Summaa anshaana mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen

ayahs.ar: فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِمۡ رَسُولࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.en: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him
ayahs.e2: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
ayahs.tr: Fa arsalnaa feehim Rasoolam minhum ani'budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِن قَوۡمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَتۡرَفۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يَأۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَأۡكُلُونَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُونَ
ayahs.en: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink
ayahs.e2: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink
ayahs.tr: Wa qaalal mala-u min qawmihil lazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi liqaaa'il Aakhirati wa atrafnaahum fil hayaatid dunyaa maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yaakulu mimmaa taakuloona minhu wa yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَطَعۡتُم بَشَرࣰ ا مِّثۡلَكُمۡ إِنَّكُمۡ إِذࣰ ا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers
ayahs.e2: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers
ayahs.tr: Wa la'in at'atum basharam mislakum innakum izal lakhaasiroon

ayahs.ar: أَيَعِدُكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ إِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخۡرَجُونَ
ayahs.en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]
ayahs.e2: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺
ayahs.tr: A-Ya'idukum annakum izaa mittum wa kuntum turaabanw wa izaaman annakum mukhrajoon

ayahs.ar: ۞هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: How far, how far, is that which you are promised
ayahs.e2: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised
ayahs.tr: Haihaata haihaata limaa too'adoon

ayahs.ar: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ
ayahs.en: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected
ayahs.e2: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected
ayahs.tr: In hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ooseen

ayahs.ar: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.en: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him
ayahs.e2: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”
ayahs.tr: In huwa illaa rajulunif taraa 'alal laahi kazibanw wa maa nahnuu lahoo bimu'mineen

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me
ayahs.e2: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلࣲ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful
ayahs.e2: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala 'ammaa qaleelil la yusbihunna naadimeen

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ غُثَآءࣰۚ فَبُعۡدࣰ ا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people
ayahs.e2: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people
ayahs.tr: Fa akhazat humus saihatu bilhaqqi faja'alnaahum ghusaaa'aa; fabu;dal lilqaw miz zaalimeen

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.en: Then We produced after them other generations
ayahs.e2: Then We raised other generations after them
ayahs.tr: Summa anshaanaa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen

ayahs.ar: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
ayahs.en: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter]
ayahs.e2: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it
ayahs.tr: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَاۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةࣰ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُۖ فَأَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُم بَعۡضࣰ ا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَحَادِيثَۚ فَبُعۡدࣰ ا لِّقَوۡمࣲ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe
ayahs.e2: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe
ayahs.tr: Summa arsalnaa Rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaaa'a ummatar Rasooluhaa kazzabooh; fa atba'naa ba'dahum ba'danw wa ja'alnaahum ahaadees; fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
ayahs.e2: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof
ayahs.tr: Summa arsalnaa Moosaa wa akhaahu Haaroona bi Aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمًا عَالِينَ
ayahs.en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people
ayahs.e2: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people
ayahs.tr: Ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman 'aaleem

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude
ayahs.e2: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”
ayahs.tr: Faqaaloo annu'minu libasharaini mislinaa wa qawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡلَكِينَ
ayahs.en: So they denied them and were of those destroyed
ayahs.e2: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed
ayahs.tr: Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanoo minal mmuhlakeen

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided
ayahs.e2: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba la'allahum yahtadoon

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةࣰ وَءَاوَيۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبۡوَةࣲ ذَاتِ قَرَارࣲ وَمَعِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water
ayahs.e2: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alnab na Maryama wa ummahooo aayatannw wa aawainaahumaaa ilaa rabwatin zaati qaraarinw wa ma'een

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعۡمَلُواْ صَٰلِحًاۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing
ayahs.e2: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do
ayahs.tr: Yaaa aiyuhar Rusulu kuloo minat taiyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.en: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me
ayahs.e2: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺
ayahs.tr: Wa inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa Ana Rabbukum fattaqoon

ayahs.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرࣰ اۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ
ayahs.en: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing
ayahs.e2: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have
ayahs.tr: Fataqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum zuburaa; kullu hizbim bimaa ladaihim farihoon

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.en: So leave them in their confusion for a time
ayahs.e2: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while
ayahs.tr: Fazarhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen

ayahs.ar: أَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالࣲ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.en: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
ayahs.e2: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children
ayahs.tr: A-yahsaboona annnamaa numiduhum bihee mimmaalinw wa baneen

ayahs.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۚ بَل لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.en: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive
ayahs.e2: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware
ayahs.tr: Nusaari'u lahum fil khairaat; bal laa yash'uroon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
ayahs.e2: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord
ayahs.tr: Innal lazeena hum min khashyati Rabbihim mushfiqoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
ayahs.e2: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum bi Aayaati Rabbihim yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
ayahs.e2: and who associate none with their Lord
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum bi Rabbihim laa yushrikoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ رَٰجِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord
ayahs.e2: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena yu'toona maaa aataw wa quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa Rabbihim raaji'oon

ayahs.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.en: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein
ayahs.e2: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead
ayahs.tr: Ulaaa'ika yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa hum lahaa saabiqoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتَٰبࣱ يَنطِقُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged
ayahs.e2: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged
ayahs.tr: Wa laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa ladainaa kitaabuny yantiqu bilhaqqi w ahum la yuzlamoon

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلࣱ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.en: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing
ayahs.e2: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed
ayahs.tr: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haazaa wa lahum a'maalum min dooni zaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهِم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـَٔرُونَ
ayahs.en: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help
ayahs.e2: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaaa akhznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi izaa hum yaj'aroon

ayahs.ar: لَا تَجۡـَٔرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.en: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us
ayahs.tr: Laa taj'arul yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡ تَنكِصُونَ
ayahs.en: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
ayahs.e2: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺
ayahs.tr: Qad kaanat Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum 'alaaa a'qaabikum tankisoon

ayahs.ar: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرࣰ ا تَهۡجُرُونَ
ayahs.en: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil
ayahs.e2: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”
ayahs.tr: Mustakbireena bihee saamiran tahjuroon

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ أَمۡ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمۡ يَأۡتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers
ayahs.e2: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers
ayahs.tr: Afalam yaddabbarrul qawla am jaaa'ahum maa lam yaati aabaaa'ahumul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging
ayahs.e2: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him
ayahs.tr: Am lam ya'rifoo Rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةُۢۚ بَلۡ جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse
ayahs.e2: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth
ayahs.tr: Am yaqooloona bihee jinnnah; bal jaaa'ahum bilhaqqi wa aksaruhum lil haqqi kaarihoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.en: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away
ayahs.e2: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it
ayahs.tr: Wa lawit taba'al haqqu ahwaaa'ahum lafasadatis samaawaatu wal ardu wa man feehinnn; bal atainaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mu'ridon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجࣰ ا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرࣱۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers
ayahs.e2: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider
ayahs.tr: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju Rabbika khairunw wa Huwa khairur raaziqeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path
ayahs.e2: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path
ayahs.tr: Wa innaka latad'oohum ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
ayahs.en: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path
ayahs.e2: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path
ayahs.tr: Wa innnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati 'anis siraati lanaakiboon

ayahs.ar: ۞وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرࣲّ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
ayahs.en: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly
ayahs.e2: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly
ayahs.tr: Wa law rahimnaahum wa kashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسۡتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
ayahs.en: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
ayahs.e2: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famastakaanoo li Rabbihim wa maa yatadarra'oon

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابࣰ ا ذَا عَذَابࣲ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
ayahs.en: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair
ayahs.e2: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaa fatahnaa 'alaihim baaban zaa 'azaabin shadeedin izaa hum feehi mublisoon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful
ayahs.e2: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks
ayahs.tr: Wa Huwal lazeee ansha a-lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idah; qaleelam maa tashkuroon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered
ayahs.e2: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered
ayahs.tr: Wa Huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخۡتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason
ayahs.e2: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand
ayahs.tr: Wa Huwal lazee yuhyee wa yumeetu wa lahukh tilaaful laili wannahaar; afalaa ta'qiloon

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ قَالُواْ مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.en: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said
ayahs.e2: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said
ayahs.tr: Bal qaaloo misla maa qaalal awwaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected
ayahs.e2: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab 'oosoon

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples
ayahs.e2: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”
ayahs.tr: Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa haazaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know
ayahs.e2: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”
ayahs.tr: Qul limanil ardu wa man feehaaa in kuntum ta'lamoon

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember
ayahs.e2: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”
ayahs.tr: Sa-yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tazakkkaroon

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne
ayahs.e2: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”
ayahs.tr: Qul mar Rabbus samaawaatis sab'i wa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him
ayahs.e2: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
ayahs.tr: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tattaqoon

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know
ayahs.e2: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”
ayahs.tr: Qul mam bi yadihee malakootu kulli shai'inw wa Huwa yujeeru wa laa yujaaru 'alaihi in kuntum ta'lamoon

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسۡحَرُونَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded
ayahs.e2: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”
ayahs.tr: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul fa annaa tus haroon

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ayahs.en: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars
ayahs.e2: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars
ayahs.tr: Bal atainaahum bil haqqi wa innahum lakaaziboon

ayahs.ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدࣲ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍۚ إِذࣰ ا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهِۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.en: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him]
ayahs.e2: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim
ayahs.tr: Mat takhazal laahu minw waladinw wa maa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaah; izal lazahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa wa la'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd; Subhaannal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon

ayahs.ar: عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him]
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺
ayahs.tr: Aalimil Ghaibi wash shahhaadati fata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon

ayahs.ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with
ayahs.tr: Qur Rabbi immmaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِي فِي ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.en: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people
ayahs.e2: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”
ayahs.tr: Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them
ayahs.e2: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with
ayahs.tr: Wa innaa 'alaaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon

ayahs.ar: ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَۚ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.en: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe
ayahs.e2: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim
ayahs.tr: Idfa' billate hiya ahsanus saiyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
ayahs.en: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils
ayahs.e2: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils
ayahs.tr: Wa qur Rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish Shayaateen

ayahs.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحۡضُرُونِ
ayahs.en: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me
ayahs.e2: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”
ayahs.tr: Wa a'oozu bika Rabbi ai-yahduroon

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرۡجِعُونِ
ayahs.en: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
ayahs.e2: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back
ayahs.tr: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a ahada humul mawtu qaala Rabbir ji'oon

ayahs.ar: لَعَلِّيٓ أَعۡمَلُ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فِيمَا تَرَكۡتُۚ كَلَّآۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَاۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرۡزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.en: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected
ayahs.e2: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected
ayahs.tr: La'alleee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa; innahaa kalimatun huwa qaaa'iluhaa wa minw waraaa'him barzakhun ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.en: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another
ayahs.e2: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown, there will be no kinship between them on that Day, nor will they ˹even care to˺ ask about one another
ayahs.tr: Fa izaa nufikha fis Soori falaaa ansaaba bainahum yawma'izinw wa laa yatasaaa'aloon

ayahs.ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
ayahs.en: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful
ayahs.e2: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful
ayahs.tr: Faman saqulat mawaazee nuhoo fa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.en: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally
ayahs.e2: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever
ayahs.tr: Wa man khaffat mawaa zeenuhoo fa ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasiroon anfusahum fee Jahannnama khaalidoon

ayahs.ar: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
ayahs.en: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles
ayahs.e2: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed
ayahs.tr: Talfahu wujoohahumun Naaru wa hum feehaa kaalihood

ayahs.ar: أَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.en: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them
ayahs.e2: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”
ayahs.tr: Alam takun Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمࣰ ا ضَآلِّينَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray
ayahs.e2: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo Rabbanaa ghalabat 'alainaa shiqwatunaa wa kunnaa qawman daaalleen

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَإِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.en: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers
ayahs.e2: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”
ayahs.tr: Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa in 'udnaa fa innaa zaalimoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ٱخۡسَـُٔواْ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
ayahs.en: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me
ayahs.e2: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺
ayahs.tr: Qaalakh sa'oo feehaa wa laa tukallimoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقࣱ مِّنۡ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful
ayahs.e2: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’
ayahs.tr: Innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khairur raahimeen

ayahs.ar: فَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.en: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them
ayahs.e2: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them
ayahs.tr: Fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyan hattaaa ansawkum zikree wa kuntum minhum tadhakoon

ayahs.ar: إِنِّي جَزَيۡتُهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]
ayahs.e2: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”
ayahs.tr: Inee jazaituhumul Yawma bimaa sabarooo annahum humul faaa'izoon

ayahs.ar: قَٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.en: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years
ayahs.e2: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala kam labistum fil ardi 'adada sineen

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا أَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمࣲ فَسۡـَٔلِ ٱلۡعَآدِّينَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate
ayahs.e2: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil 'aaaddeen

ayahs.ar: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰ اۖ لَّوۡ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known
ayahs.e2: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew
ayahs.tr: Qaala il labistum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon

ayahs.ar: أَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ أَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ عَبَثࣰ ا وَأَنَّكُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned
ayahs.e2: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”
ayahs.tr: Afahsibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abasanw wa annakum ilainaa laa turja'oon

ayahs.ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
ayahs.en: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne
ayahs.e2: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne
ayahs.tr: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Kareem

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed
ayahs.e2: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed
ayahs.tr: Wa mai yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa innnamaa hisaabuhoo 'inda Rabbih; innahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.en: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qur Rabbigh fir warham wa Anta khairur raahimeen
